description: This file defines the TaxComponent entity class for the Fineract project, representing a tax component with attributes such as name, percentage, associated accounts, and start date. It includes methods for creation, updating, and retrieving applicable percentages and related histories.

classes.name: TaxComponent
classes.description: Represents a tax component with properties such as name, percentage, accounts, start date, and histories, used within tax-related calculations and configurations.

methods.name: createTaxComponent
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate a new TaxComponent with specified properties.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the tax component's properties based on a JsonCommand, recording changes and creating new history entries as needed.

methods.name: updateStartDate
methods.description: Sets or updates the start date of the tax component based on command inputs or defaults to current business date.

methods.name: getPercentage
methods.description: Returns the applicable percentage of tax.

methods.name: startDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the tax component.

methods.name: getApplicablePercentage
methods.description: Determines the applicable percentage for a given date based on start date and history.

methods.name: getTaxComponentHistories
methods.description: Returns the set of historical percentage changes for this tax component.

methods.name: getTaxGroupMappings
methods.description: Returns group mappings associated with this tax component.

methods.name: allStartDates
methods.description: Returns a collection of all start dates related to this tax component, including historical ones.

methods.name: getDebitAccountType
methods.description: Returns the account type of the debit account.

methods.name: getCreditAccountType
methods.description: Returns the account type of the credit account.
